chunks: As for whatever is in it from Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah al-Ruba'i.

key_terms.الرَّبَعِيِّ: A tribal attribution identifying Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah al-Ruba'i.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s mode of narration.
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْحِمْيَرِ: A key intermediary narrator in the transmission chain.
key_terms.مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ: A transmitter whose narrations are being traced in this chain-reference.
key_terms.هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ: Another intermediary narrator in the sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It serves as a chain-reference statement identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah.
